name: @activepieces/piece-reply-io
description: Sales engagement platform for contacts, campaigns, and outbound outreach workflows.

auth.description: Your Reply.io API key. Find it in Reply.io under **Settings → API**.

get_contact.name: get_contact
get_contact.description: Look up a contact in Reply.io by their email address and retrieve their details.

email.description: Email address of the contact to look up.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a single Reply.io contact and their profile/stats by exact email address. Use to check whether a contact exists or to read their current details before acting on them. Email is required; this is a read-only lookup that is safe to retry.

create_or_update_contact.name: create_or_update_contact
create_or_update_contact.description: Add a new contact to Reply.io, or update their details if a contact with that email already exists.

email.description: The contact's email address. Used to identify and deduplicate contacts.

company.description: The company or organisation the contact works for.

title.description: Contact's job title, e.g. "VP of Sales" or "Marketing Manager".

linkedInProfile.description: Full URL to the contact's LinkedIn profile, e.g. https://linkedin.com/in/janedoe

city.description: City the contact is based in.

state.description: State or province the contact is based in.

country.description: Country the contact is based in.

timeZoneId.description: IANA time zone name used to schedule emails at the right local time, e.g. "America/New_York" or "Europe/London".

aiMetadata.description: Upsert a contact in Reply.io keyed on email: creates the contact if the email is new, otherwise updates the existing record with the supplied fields. Use to store or refresh contact details without enrolling them in any campaign. Email and first name are required; repeating with the same input converges to the same stored record.

delete_contact.name: delete_contact
delete_contact.description: Permanently delete a contact from Reply.io by their email address. This cannot be undone.

email.description: Email address of the contact to permanently delete.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently delete a contact from Reply.io by exact email address; this also removes them from any campaigns and cannot be undone. Use only when the contact record should be erased entirely rather than just stopped (prefer the remove-from-campaign or mark actions to merely halt outreach). Repeating the call leaves the contact deleted, so it is safe to retry.

create_and_push_to_campaign.name: create_and_push_to_campaign
create_and_push_to_campaign.description: Create a new contact (or update an existing one) and immediately enrol them in a campaign so they start receiving outreach emails.

auth.description: Your Reply.io API key. Find it in Reply.io under **Settings → API**.

email.description: The contact's email address. Used to identify and deduplicate contacts.

company.description: The company or organisation the contact works for.

title.description: Contact's job title, e.g. "VP of Sales" or "Marketing Manager".

linkedInProfile.description: Full URL to the contact's LinkedIn profile, e.g. https://linkedin.com/in/janedoe

notes.description: Internal notes about this contact. Not visible to the contact.

city.description: City the contact is based in.

state.description: State or province the contact is based in.

country.description: Country the contact is based in.

timeZoneId.description: IANA time zone name used to schedule emails at the right local time, e.g. "America/New_York" or "Europe/London".

aiMetadata.description: Upsert a contact (by email) and in the same call enrol them into the given campaign so outbound outreach begins. Use when adding a brand-new lead to a sequence in one step; if the contact already exists in Reply.io, prefer Push Contact to Campaign instead. Requires a target campaign id plus email and first name. Not idempotent: it enrolls the contact and starts sending outreach on each call.

push_to_campaign.name: push_to_campaign
push_to_campaign.description: Enrol an existing contact in a campaign so they start receiving outreach emails. Enable "Force Push" to move the contact even if they are already active in another campaign.

auth.description: Your Reply.io API key. Find it in Reply.io under **Settings → API**.

email.description: Email address of the contact to add to the campaign.

forcePush.description: Move the contact into this campaign even if they are already active in another campaign. Leave off to skip contacts already in an active campaign.

aiMetadata.description: Enrol an already-existing Reply.io contact (by email) into a campaign so outbound outreach begins; the optional Force Push flag moves them in even if they are already active in another campaign (otherwise such contacts are skipped). Use when the contact already exists and only needs to be added to a sequence; use Add Contact to Campaign instead if you also need to create the contact. Requires a target campaign id and the contact email. Not idempotent: it enrolls and starts sending outreach on each call.

remove_from_campaign.name: remove_from_campaign
remove_from_campaign.description: Stop a contact from receiving further emails in a specific campaign. The contact's record is kept in Reply.io.

auth.description: Your Reply.io API key. Find it in Reply.io under **Settings → API**.

email.description: Email address of the contact to remove from the campaign.

aiMetadata.description: Remove a contact (by email) from one specific campaign so they stop receiving its outreach, while keeping their contact record and any other campaign enrolments intact. Use to pull a contact out of a single sequence; use Remove Contact from All Campaigns to halt every sequence at once. Requires the target campaign id and the contact email. Idempotent: repeating leaves the contact removed from that campaign.

remove_from_all_campaigns.name: remove_from_all_campaigns
remove_from_all_campaigns.description: Remove a contact from every campaign they are enrolled in. No further emails will be sent to them. Their contact record is kept in Reply.io.

email.description: Email address of the contact to remove from all campaigns.

aiMetadata.description: Remove a contact (by email) from every campaign they are enrolled in so no further outreach is sent, while keeping their contact record in Reply.io. Use to fully stop outreach to someone without deleting them; use Remove Contact from Campaign to pull them from just one sequence. Requires only the contact email. Idempotent: repeating leaves the contact out of all campaigns.

mark_replied.name: mark_replied
mark_replied.description: Record that a contact has replied to your outreach. This stops further follow-up emails to that contact across all active campaigns.

email.description: Email address of the contact to mark as replied.

aiMetadata.description: Mark a contact (by email) as having replied, which stops further follow-up emails to them across all active campaigns. Use when a reply has been detected and outreach should pause for that reason specifically (vs. Mark Contact as Finished, which closes them out as fully completed). Requires only the contact email. Idempotent: repeating leaves the contact in the replied state.

mark_finished.name: mark_finished
mark_finished.description: Mark a contact as finished so they no longer receive emails in any campaign. Use this when you have completed all outreach to that contact.

email.description: Email address of the contact to mark as finished.

aiMetadata.description: Mark a contact (by email) as finished so they no longer receive emails in any campaign, signalling that all outreach to them is complete. Use to close out a contact whose sequence is done (vs. Mark Contact as Replied, which pauses specifically because they responded). Requires only the contact email. Idempotent: repeating leaves the contact in the finished state.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description: Your Reply.io API key. Find it in Reply.io under **Settings → API**.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

auth.description: Your Reply.io API key. Find it in Reply.io under **Settings → API**.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

de.Sales engagement platform for contacts,: Vertriebsplattform für Kontakte, Kampagnen und ausgehende Outbound-Workflows.
Ihr Reply.io API-Schlüssel. Finden Sie ihn unter Reply.io unter **Einstellungen → API**.
de.Look up a contact in Reply.io by their e: Suchen Sie einen Kontakt in Reply.io durch ihre E-Mail-Adresse und holen Sie ihre Details.
de.Add a new contact to Reply.io, or update: Fügen Sie einen neuen Kontakt zu Reply.io hinzu, oder aktualisieren Sie ihre Daten, wenn bereits ein Kontakt mit dieser E-Mail existiert.
Löschen Sie einen Kontakt dauerhaft von Reply.io über seine E-Mail-Adresse. Dies kann nicht rückgängig gemacht werden.
de.Create a new contact (or update an exist: Erstellen Sie einen neuen Kontakt (oder aktualisieren Sie einen bereits existierenden Kontakt) und melden Sie ihn sofort in einer Kampagne an, damit sie anfangen, Outtreach-E-Mails zu erhalten.
de.Enrol an existing contact in a campaign: Melden Sie sich an einen bestehenden Kontakt in einer Kampagne, so dass sie anfangen, Outtreach-E-Mails zu erhalten. Aktivieren Sie "Erzwinge Push", um den Kontakt zu verschieben, auch wenn er bereits in einer anderen Kampagne aktiv ist.
de.Stop a contact from receiving further em: Beenden Sie einen Kontakt vom Empfang weiterer E-Mails in einer bestimmten Kampagne. Die Aufzeichnung des Kontakts wird in Reply.io gespeichert.
de.Remove a contact from every campaign the: Entferne einen Kontakt aus jeder Kampagne, in der sie eingeschrieben sind. Es werden keine weiteren E-Mails an sie versendet. Ihre Kontaktdaten werden in Reply.io gespeichert.
de.Record that a contact has replied to you: Legen Sie fest, dass ein Kontakt auf Ihren Zugang geantwortet hat. Dies stoppt weitere Nachfass-E-Mails zu diesem Kontakt über alle aktiven Kampagnen.
de.Mark a contact as finished so they no lo: Markieren Sie einen Kontakt als fertig, damit er keine E-Mails mehr in einer Kampagne erhält. Benutzen Sie diese Option, wenn Sie den gesamten Kontakt abgeschlossen haben.

E-Mail-Adresse des Kontakts, um nach oben zu suchen.

de.The company or organisation the contact: Das Unternehmen oder die Organisation, für die der Kontakt arbeitet.
de.Contact's job title, e.g. \"VP of Sales\: Kontaktieren Sie den Jobtitel, z.B. "VP of Sales" oder "Marketing Manager".

de.State or province the contact is based i: Bundesland oder Provinz, in dem der Kontakt seinen Sitz hat.
Land in dem der Kontakt basiert.
de.IANA time zone name used to schedule ema: IANA Zeitzonenname wurde verwendet, um E-Mails zur richtigen Ortszeit zu planen, z.B. "America/New_York" oder "Europe/London".
de.Email address of the contact to permanen: Email-Adresse des Kontakts, der dauerhaft gelöscht werden soll.
de.Internal notes about this contact. Not v: Interne Notizen zu diesem Kontakt. Nicht sichtbar für den Kontakt.
de.Email address of the contact to add to t: E-Mail-Adresse des Kontakts, der zur Kampagne hinzugefügt werden soll.
de.Move the contact into this campaign even: Verschieben Sie den Kontakt in diese Kampagne, auch wenn er bereits in einer anderen Kampagne aktiv ist. Lassen Sie es aus, um bereits in einer aktiven Kampagne Kontakte zu überspringen.

fr.Remove Contact from Campaign: Supprimer le contact de la campagne
fr.Remove Contact from All Campaigns: Supprimer le contact de toutes les campagnes

zh.Sales engagement platform for contacts,: Sales engagement platform for contacts, campaigns, and outbound outreach workflows.
Your Reply.io API key. Find it in Reply.io under **Settings → API**.
zh.Look up a contact in Reply.io by their e: Look up a contact in Reply.io by their email address and retrieve their details.
zh.Add a new contact to Reply.io, or update: Add a new contact to Reply.io, or update their details if a contact with that email already exists.
Permanently delete a contact from Reply.io by their email address. This cannot be undone.
zh.Create a new contact (or update an exist: Create a new contact (or update an existing one) and immediately enrol them in a campaign so they start receiving outreach emails.
zh.Enrol an existing contact in a campaign: Enrol an existing contact in a campaign so they start receiving outreach emails. Enable "Force Push" to move the contact even if they are already active in another campaign.
zh.Stop a contact from receiving further em: Stop a contact from receiving further emails in a specific campaign. The contact's record is kept in Reply.io.
zh.Remove a contact from every campaign the: Remove a contact from every campaign they are enrolled in. No further emails will be sent to them. Their contact record is kept in Reply.io.
zh.Record that a contact has replied to you: Record that a contact has replied to your outreach. This stops further follow-up emails to that contact across all active campaigns.
zh.Mark a contact as finished so they no lo: Mark a contact as finished so they no longer receive emails in any campaign. Use this when you have completed all outreach to that contact.

pt.Sales engagement platform for contacts,: Plataforma de envolvimento de vendas para contatos, campanhas e saídas de fluxos de trabalho.
A sua chave API Reply.io. Encontre em Reply.io em **Configurações → API**.
pt.Look up a contact in Reply.io by their e: Procure um contato no Reply.io pelo endereço de e-mail deles e recupere seus detalhes.
pt.Add a new contact to Reply.io, or update: Adicione um novo contato para Responder.io, ou atualize seus detalhes se já existir um contato com esse email.
Excluir permanentemente um contato do Reply.io pelo seu endereço de e-mail. Isto não pode ser desfeito.
pt.Create a new contact (or update an exist: Crie um novo contato (ou atualize um já existente) e inscreva-o imediatamente em uma campanha para que eles comecem a receber e-mails de divulgação.
pt.Enrol an existing contact in a campaign: Inscreva um contato existente em uma campanha para que eles comecem a receber e-mails. Habilite "Force Push" para mover o contato, mesmo se eles já estão ativos em outra campanha.
pt.Stop a contact from receiving further em: Impeça que um contato receba novos e-mails em uma campanha específica. O registro do contato é mantido em Reply.io.
pt.Remove a contact from every campaign the: Remover um contato de cada campanha na qual eles estão inscritos. Nenhum e-mail adicional será enviado para eles. O registro do contato deles é mantido em Reply.io.
pt.Record that a contact has replied to you: Grave que um contato respondeu à sua divulgação. Isso para um acompanhamento de e-mails para esse contato em todas as campanhas ativas.
pt.Mark a contact as finished so they no lo: Marque um contato como concluído, para que ele não receba mais e-mails em qualquer campanha. Use isso quando você concluir toda a proximidade ao contato.
pt.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Faça uma chamada de API personalizada para um ponto de extremidade específico
Endereço de e-mail do contato para consultar.
pt.The contact's email address. Used to ide: O endereço de e-mail do contato. Usado para identificar e duplicar contatos.
pt.The company or organisation the contact: A empresa ou organização para a qual contato.
pt.Contact's job title, e.g. \"VP of Sales\: Título de trabalho do contato, ex.: "VP of Vendas" ou "Gerente de Marketing".
pt.Full URL to the contact's LinkedIn profi: URL completa para o perfil do LinkedIn do contato, por exemplo, https://linkedin.com/in/janedoe
Cidade na qual o contato se baseia.
pt.State or province the contact is based i: Estado ou província onde o contato se baseia.
País no qual o contato é baseado
pt.IANA time zone name used to schedule ema: Nome do fuso horário da IANA usado para agendar e-mails à hora local correta, por exemplo, "América/New_York" ou "Europa/Londres".
pt.Email address of the contact to permanen: E-mail do contato para excluir permanentemente.
pt.Internal notes about this contact. Not v: Notas internas sobre este contato. Não visível para o contato.
pt.Email address of the contact to add to t: Endereço de e-mail do contato para adicionar à campanha.
pt.Move the contact into this campaign even: Mova o contato para esta campanha, mesmo se eles já estiverem ativos em outra campanha. Deixe em branco para pular contatos já em uma campanha ativa.
pt.Email address of the contact to remove f: E-mail do endereço de e-mail do contato para remover da campanha.
E-mail do endereço de contato para remover de todas as campanhas.
pt.Email address of the contact to mark as: Endereço de e-mail do contato para marcar como respondido.
Endereço de e-mail do contato a ser marcado como concluído.
pt.Authorization headers are injected autom: Os cabeçalhos de autorização são inseridos automaticamente a partir da sua conexão.
